blurb: Guests rent boats, jet skis, paddle boards, and other watercraft at Ideal Beach. Optional damage protection and cancellation insurance are available. Guided experiences and winter rentals are also offered at related locations.
extraNote: Cancellation and adjustment insurance: $50 for reservations under $1,500, or 10% of rental cost for reservations over $1,500; cancel or modify up to 24 hours before start time · Damage protection cost $30 per machine for rentals up to 4 hours, $50 for 5-8 hours; max out-of-pocket $1,500 for watercraft · Damage protection void if damages occur while violating water laws; full repair cost responsibility then · Ideal Beach Resort, 2176 S Bear Lake Blvd, Garden City, UT 84028
